# Vendored third-party assets

- `three.module.js`, `loaders/GLTFLoader.js`, `utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js`,
  `utils/SkeletonUtils.js`, `models/RobotExpressive.glb`
  — from the [three.js](https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js) project
  (`mrdoob/three.js`, tag `r160`), MIT License, Copyright © 2010-2023 three.js
  authors. `RobotExpressive.glb` is part of three.js's official example
  assets (`examples/models/gltf/RobotExpressive/`), used here as a stand-in
  duel-avatar body while per-avatar modeling is a separate phase (see the
  project brief, section 7 — avatar 3D modeling is explicitly out of scope
  for the prototype).
